targets.recordKey: entity.Id = Row.genaccountcoursesId (main.cs:127) = ac.gen_accountcoursesId from source 'get restrictions and accounts balance' (SQL DTSX 3885) - the account course (מסלול בחשבון) being synchronised with its fund main
targets.writeCondition: Data flow runs after 'Create ETL Process record' (Success, DTSX 5506). Source rows (SQL DTSX 3884-3902, conn [CRM] = psql/altshuler_mscrm): every gen_accountcourses joined (inner) to its Gen_fundmain (ac.gen_fundnumber = f.Gen_fundmainId) that is linked to at least one OPEN process: Gen_transferin with Gen_CurrentState = 1, or Gen_customercare with Gen_currentstate = 1, or Gen_withdrawal with Gen_currentstate = 1 (left joins + WHERE ... is not null). In the script the entity is added to the batch only if at least one attribute differs (needToUpdate, main.cs:128, 151-160); otherwise the row goes to output DontNeedToUpdate (no path). An exception while building the entity or while flushing a batch sends the CURRENT row to CastingError (main.cs:162-171) - see notes on batch failure. ExecuteMultiple faults per request go to the Error output (main.cs:190-194). Both feed ETL Warning (plumbing).
targets.expression: entity["gen_isconfiscate"] = Row.genisconfiscate (bool, unchanged); else-branch entity[...] = null is unreachable in practice because the source column is ISNULL(f.Gen_isConfiscate,0) (never NULL). Source value = ISNULL(Gen_fundmain.Gen_isConfiscate, 0) of the fund main linked by ac.gen_fundnumber.
targets.attrCondition: Helpers.CheckIfToUpdate2(ref Row, "genisconfiscate") must return true, i.e. !IsEqual("Boolean", genisconfiscate, genisconfiscateDB). AttributeType = PropertyType.Name of genisconfiscateDB = "Boolean" (BufferWrapper: public Boolean genisconfiscateDB, DTSX 4495); the switch has only case "bool", so "Boolean" falls to default: return true (equal). Result: written ONLY when exactly one side is NULL - in practice only when the current account-course value gen_isconfiscateDB (ac.gen_isconfiscate) IS NULL. A change 0->1 or 1->0 on the fund main is NEVER propagated.

notes.note: Scope: the lineage lists 3 script write components. Only 'Update Account courses\Update AccountCourcess' is business logic (5 attributes on gen_accountcourses). 'Update Account courses\ETL Warning' (Create gen_etlprocesswarning) and 'End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish' (Update gen_etlprocess) are ETL plumbing and are not mapped; their open script outputs (Update AccountCourcess.CastingError/Error.ErrorText, Get gen_etlprocessid.gen_etlprocessid) are intentionally left unresolved. Control-flow 'Create ETL Process record' and OnError 'Error ETL Process record' are plumbing too.

Boolean comparison defect (high impact): Helpers.CheckIfToUpdate2 takes the type name from PropertyType.Name of the *DB column; for the 4 bit columns this is "Boolean" (BufferWrapper DTSX 4480-4645), but IsEqual handles only "bool" (Helpers.cs:50), so default: return true (Helpers.cs:60-61). gen_isconfiscate / gen_iswarning / gen_ismortgaged / gen_isreceivership are therefore written only when the account-course value is NULL; real changes on the fund main (0<->1) are never propagated. Based on embedded source; the compiled DLL was not decompiled.
gen_transactionpercent (ac.gen_transactionpercent, SQL DTSX 3887) is an input of the writer but is never used by the code.

Record key is entity.Id only (main.cs:127); no attribute named gen_accountcoursesid is set. Attributes set: 5 (main.cs:132-135, 146). Commented placeholders //DATETIME //Float //INT //LOOKUP //STRING //PICKLIST (main.cs:137-149) contain no code; '//service.Update(entity);' (main.cs:153) is commented out - writes go only through ExecuteMultiple.

Batch failure handling: ExcecuteBulk() is called inside the per-row try (main.cs:155-156). If it throws, only the current row is sent to CastingError and myEntities.Clear() (main.cs:202) is skipped; the list then holds > 10 entities, so the '== 10' check never fires again and all remaining entities are sent in ONE request at EndOfRowset (main.cs:211-214), outside any try - a failure there fails the component. Also, response.Results[1] is read by index (main.cs:180); ExecuteMultipleExtension (CRM.Proxy / CRM2015.Proxy.dll) is not supplied (external_unknown), so ContinueOnError / ordering settings are unknown.

Row multiplicity: each source row is one gen_accountcourses; the inner join to Gen_fundmain and the three left joins (Gen_transferin, Gen_customercare, Gen_withdrawal) are each on the joined view's own <entity>Id column (SQL DTSX 3898-3901), which by CRM view convention is the primary key, so at most one row per account course is expected. Not verified against the database schema (out of scope).
